Spokane Bicycle Club Monday Riverside State Park Ride

Spokane, WA · Audubon / Downriver · Road

Spokane Bicycle Club Monday Riverside State Park Ride is a road group ride in Spokane, WA. It rolls every Monday at 9:00 am from Little Garden Cafe. About 26 miles, 12–14 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spokane Bicycle Club Monday Riverside State Park Ride group ride

A Monday morning club ride out to Riverside State Park. 26 miles at 12–14 mph. The club posts every ride on its Meetup page, including a Thursday ride from the same cafe.
